items.title: Bobby Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: we appeared on “The Tonight Show” on the Johnny Carson show four times in one year

ctx.x: He’s got such a unique — what’s he like as a person?

He’s a very nice person. And he’s very nice to me. And we appeared on “The Tonight Show” on the Johnny Carson show four times in one year. And he always was nice to me. That’s the reason I moved out to California, because I left New York, Leon and I were in a — I don’t know if I should say — a plane crash together. We were in Allegheny Airlines going from Morgantown, West Virginia. We were playing at the University of West Virginia, and we were in a plane crash that crashed right after takeoff. And he was hurt…
Wow. You were just talking about how hot it is out there now.
